reason: Known Finding KF-P0-07 remains active on fresh main 3ba8940952b4788746deb18bf4dd683be9f46ecb: package.json pins @whiskeysockets/baileys 7.0.0-rc13 and root postinstall mutates two installed Baileys runtime files after the already-trusted official tarball has been verified and cached. The executed runtime bytes therefore differ from the dependency identity bound by package-lock and governance/dependency-install-policy.json. Upstream tag v7.0.0-rc14 contains both required trusted-contact-token semantics natively: profile-picture token content is nested under the picture query node, and tctoken requires/preserves the timestamp attribute. The rc13 and rc14 upstream package manifests declare the same production dependency ranges, so this batch authorizes only the Baileys package identity transition and retirement of the postinstall mutation path; unrelated transitive identity churn is out of scope.
